column1: # Interaction rows: a pose plus the keys/console commands that make the retail engine act.
# Same format as shots.tsv; the harness applies `-Keys`/`-KeysAfter` and `-ConsoleCommands` to every row.
# katarn_ai_face: level 3's spawn position turned to face the Tuskens (retail yaw -90 = +y; the port's
# trace at this pose reports actors at (-0.61,-2.41) and (-1.43,-3.19), 2.3 and 1.7 units away). Same
# coordinates as the level's own spawn, so the warp is accepted; only the facing changes.
# katarn_ai_193: the vantage computed from the map data (`--thing-list`): thing 193 (`tuskanbh`) stands
# at (0.186,-3.491,-0.280), 1.6 units from the spawn, at retail yaw -53 from (-0.76,-4.74). The port's
# frame from here shows the Tuskan by the fence, so this is the engagement pose: retail yaw -53 is
# secret_enter: level 1's first secret sector (243, link 1 of `00_SecretAreas.cog` at placed cog index
# 28, centre from `--sector-locate 28`). The cog's `entered:` handler ORs the sender id into `flags`,
# so a warp into the sector is a **movement** trigger with no input to synthesise: retail's console
# `cogstatus 28` after the warp reads the same variable the port's `--cogstatus-after 28` prints.
# Round 198 already measured retail flags 0 -> 2 here; this row makes it a repeatable fixture.
